example.title: Quayside cold-store block at Fishermen's Terminal (used as the ice house)
example.place: Fishermen's Terminal, Seattle, King County, WA

brief: A 1980s two-storey cold-store and gear building on the quay: a plain block of grey-blue painted concrete with small square windows and a flat roof, standing on the timber bulkhead with a pickup parked on the apron and boats hauled out beside it. One photo. It stands in for the ice house: no West Coast harbour ice plant has photos on Commons. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
